title: docs(polli-cli): fix stale 'quests mine' examples in README
author: wiradifit
pr_body_excerpt: ## Summary The `polli-cli` README documents a `polli quests mine` command in two places, but the `quests` command takes no positional arguments — commander rejects it with: ``` error: too many arguments for 'quests'. Expected 0 arguments but got 1. ``` ## Changes - `polli quests mine` → `polli quests --claimed` - `polli quests mine --completed` → `polli quests --claimable` These match the real interface in `packages/polli-cli/src/commands/quests.ts` (filter flags: `--open`, `--claimable`, `--claimed`, `--coming-soon`) and the examples already used correctly in `SKILL.md`. ## Verification - Reproduced the failure on polli 0.1.10: `polli quests mine` → argument-count error - Confirmed via code search this was the only file still referencing `quests mine` ## Quest link Contributes to the Contribute-a-pull-request quest 🌱 ## Screenshoot

gist.headline: Quest flags find their way
gist.blurb: The CLI quest map now points to commands that actually open the door. Polli gave two stale examples a tiny, well-earned prune.
gist.summary: Updated the polli-cli README examples from the invalid `polli quests mine` syntax to the supported `polli quests --claimed` and `polli quests --claimable` filters.
gist.impact: CLI users can now copy the README commands to view claimed or claimable Quests without Commander rejecting an extra positional argument.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a small explorer hat and holding a corrected quest map, points a friendly monitor robot toward two garden signposts labeled `--claimed` and `--claimable`; crossed-out `quests mine` directions sit in a compost bin beside blooming code-plants.
